description: Ministry of Higher Education, Technology & Innovations - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex.No. 1518/15 of 09.10.2007 which Specifies the Faculties & Departments of the University of Jaffna
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of university faculties and departments through a legal order issued under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It constitutes a regulatory change to the academic structure of the University of Jaffna, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to implement a regulatory amendment, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
